fixture.rows: all eight existing training fixture rows; same episode, not eight independent scenes
fixture.images: stored encoded current frames only; no new corpus or outcome labels

preprocessing.decoder: cv2.imdecode IMREAD_COLOR; preserve existing native encoded-image convention without channel swap

tests: strict native model weight load; expected z48 spatial16 temporal4 causal
all eight single training frames: finite 1x48x1x24x20 latents; reuse stored DINO geometry only
same first frame, next eight frames pixel-inverted: first latent max absolute difference <=1e-6, future latent must change
single-frame vs repeated-video first latent max absolute difference <=1e-6
same exact original single-frame after other encodes: max absolute difference <=1e-6 (cache reset)
one native non-tiled single-frame pixel decode: finite 1x3x1x384x320, diagnostic MSE only
record per-operation wall time, peak allocated memory, native and per-token-LN pooled vector norms, no label readouts
exclusions: no RAE or policy benefit claim
failure_policy: retain raw failures, do not silently relax thresholds; any engineering continuation separately recorded
